findings: The 2026-11-07 base capture is navigation only: it names Checkout, Direct API, iOS and Android variants but supplies no variant bodies or new request, authentication, mandate, revocation, or success rules (new raw lines 5-17). The current source is anchored only to the prior raw in frontmatter and describes older detailed guidance without a date qualification (source lines 4-7, 11-31, 35). Add the November navigation raw as separately dated provenance while keeping the older raw; do not redate or attribute old behavior to November.

Material baseline accuracy defect independent of the navigation delta: source line 19 states Checkout payment_method_types ['cashapp'], whereas the old raw Checkout Session example uses ['card', 'cashapp'] and mode setup with customer and success_url (old raw lines 68-79). Correct the example attribution rather than implying a current required list.

The older direct API browser flow invokes it (old raw lines 247-284); the old iOS and Android variants instead use STPPaymentHandler.confirmSetupIntent and PaymentLauncher.confirm (old raw lines 598-624, 774-818), and Checkout creates a setup-mode Session (old raw lines 51-79). Scope the method to the old Direct API/Stripe.js route.

The source's three-path grouping (source line 17) can remain as Checkout, Direct API, mobile grouped, but the November index visibly links four individual variants (new raw lines 13-17). Name the four routes for retrieval and do not imply their unread November bodies were reviewed.

The wallet concept repeats older setup details without a clear dated qualification at lines 157-159; a small source-route/date qualification is relevant when this job is promoted. The separate Cash App Pay subscription concept at lines 20-22 already distinguishes its own November index and is not authority for this setup URL.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/cash-app-pay/set-up-payment, the complete November capture establishes the page purpose—saving Cash App Pay details for later charges—and four navigation destinations: Checkout, Direct API, iOS and Android (new raw lines 5-17). It gives no variant body, prerequisites, request fields or success states. The matched older May 7, 2026 capture documents a Customer-associated Checkout setup Session, Direct API SetupIntent or PaymentIntent saving, and platform-specific mobile confirmation; requires_action, customer authentication and succeeded are separate boundaries (old raw lines 33-79, 95-105, 157-174, 284-296, 345-427, 558-624, 745-818). The mapped source-stripe-cash-app-pay-set-up-payment.md summarizes those older paths, but its Checkout type list drops card from the old example (source line 19; old raw lines 68-79) and its unscoped confirmCashappSetup phrase should be limited to Direct API browser use (source line 13; old raw lines 266-284).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/cash-app-pay/set-up-payment, the observed change is a navigation and presentation change from the older combined guide to a November variant index, not a demonstrated change to Cash App Pay capability (old raw lines 4-18, 95-107, 439-449, 657-661; new raw lines 9-17). source-stripe-cash-app-pay-set-up-payment.md should retain its older raw with May 7, 2026 attribution, add the new index route, and correct the conflicting Checkout example: old raw line 74 shows card plus cashapp while source line 19 lists cashapp alone. Its Direct API Stripe.js method, 10-minute setup authentication, 30-second mobile_auth_url, first-save authorization notice and revocation webhooks remain dated and route-specific (old raw lines 140-148, 266-296, 345-361, 430-437). Neither following a link, displaying a QR code, redirecting to Cash App nor creating an Intent proves authenticated setup, successful payment or future charge. The November variants' current bodies and SDK versions remain unread here.
